static.title: Parallax to distance
static.note: A parallax measures 1 ÷ distance, with an error. It is not the distance. This panel draws the likelihood of every distance for the numbers you set. Its maximum is 1 ÷ the corrected parallax, and with no prior that is all it says. A point distance needs a corrected parallax at least 5 times its error. Switch the prior on to see what a prior adds and what it assumes. The numbers are ones you set: this is not a Gaia star.
